scope.policy: Sequential AUTO: each FREE maximizes exact conditional expected payout; ties choose the lowest cell ID.
scope.payoutBasis: Hundredths of BET, before the existing whole-medal floor.
scope.lowBetCaveat: For BET values not divisible by 10, floor(BET * totalHundredths / 100) can reduce the paid return. No per-BET correction is claimed.
scope.manualPlayCaveat: Other legal FREE choices can produce a different expected return.
scope.finiteSessionCaveat: These are exact expectations, not a guarantee for an individual session.

oddsSources: Place yellow FREE on an initial green FREE.
A numbered HIT lands on a placed yellow FREE.

method.description: Enumerate all C(25,5) early sets for each initial layout, evaluate sequential AUTO at budgets 1–4, integrate all C(20,3) late sets using integer inclusion/exclusion, then weight budgets by Hypergeometric(25,3,5).
method.noMonteCarloOrConfidenceInterval: Every component of this AUTO expectation is exact; independent brute-force late-set vectors check the evaluator.

preliminarySearch.note: Historic v285 search retained in docs/dango-v285-calibration.json; v287 coefficients and outcomes recalculated independently.
